_note: products-price-lists (D1, D2): a price list per customer segment, country or client, and a client's country and own price list. New schema priceList; client gains two optional fields and moves to 1.7.0.

priceList.title: Price list
priceList.summary: Prices for a customer segment, a country or one client
priceList.description: A price list: the prices of products for the clients in its segments or countries, or for a client that has it as its own list, in one currency and for a period.
priceList.x-notes: products-price-lists D1: the entries live inside the list, so a list is copied, archived and audited as one thing. The resolver reads active lists valid today in the requested currency: the client's own list first, then lists for its segment, then for its country, highest priority first.

title.title: Name
title.description: The list's name, shown on a quote line it priced.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency of the list's prices; a quote in another currency does not use it.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: The first day the list applies; empty means from the start.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: The last day the list applies; empty means without end.

segments.title: Customer segments
segments.description: The client segments the list applies to, such as public-sector.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries of the clients the list applies to.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: When several lists match, the highest priority prices the line.

entries.title: Prices
entries.description: The price of a product, optionally for one variant and from a minimum quantity.

country.title: Country
country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the client, such as NL; price lists for that country apply to it.

priceList.title: Price list
priceList.description: The client's own price list; it goes before any list for its segment or country.
